column4: expo install --check passes: the four Expo packages are back in step with SDK 57.
ESLint ignores generated test output and audit scratch so lint no longer crashes after a browser test run.
shell-quote is held at 1.12 by an override and npm audit fix took 13 advisories to 6 (none critical); decode-uri-component has no usable fix until expo-router moves off query-string 7.
react-native-purchases is pinned to 10.11.0 like the other native modules.
A store build bundles recipes.store.json (271 recipes) instead of all 5496; store web bundle 15.8 MB to 5.9 MB measured.
audit/deep-1120 is pushed to GitHub; making it main and pushing local main are the owner's.
Banning or deleting the 99 seed sign-ins is a live write on the server; it waits for the owner's yes (K-40).
Removing the unused RevenueCat entitlement is a RevenueCat change; it waits for the owner (K-38).
Storage plan and clean-up are the owner's (K-24).
Both halves done: Plan progress and the Collect sheet (f606ccf) and the Plan badge and empty collection (2086fe4) skip recipes that are gone.
Both halves done: sign-out is refused while anything is set aside (b4b1f62) and Settings shows what is set aside (397c22a; proved by a component test not a screenshot).
The recipe page names the lines it couldn't check (864d47f) and the ingredient database learnt the five missing allergen words (c86b381).
Both halves are written: the private token store and functions (e7ec90b) and the app's calls (0669db8). Nothing is live until the migrations are applied and the owner sets the Apple key and deploys.
CI actions and PGlite are pinned; the stale files on the Mac (expo-preview.pid and pantry-overnight) are left for the owner.
Every launch draft and the in-app recipe wording (3e921d4) now match the store build; the lawyer review and hosting are the owner's.
